purpose: Read-only diagnosis of the exact Python source audit verifier mismatch.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rt_py_diag',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)

print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)); print('PYTHON_AUDIT_VERIFIER_DIAG_COMPLETE')
PY
